name: Surveyor 2
about: Surveyor 2 (1966-084A, NASA/JPL), launched 1966 Sep 20. Its phases from GCAT: Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
GCAT gives a straight-in path to the ground, periapsis below the surface
